the experience

What we'll do together

This is a hands-on, go-at-your-own-pace workshop. No experience needed — Monty guides you through every step so you leave with something alive and beautiful.

🪨

Layer the foundation

Gravel, activated charcoal, and soil — we'll build the ecosystem layer by layer so your terrarium stays healthy long after you leave.

🌱

Choose & place your plants

Pick from a curated selection of ferns, mosses, and succulents. Monty helps you design a tiny living landscape that suits your space and style.

🍄

Add your personal touches

Pebbles, driftwood, little mushrooms — make it yours. Every terrarium tells a different story.

🏡

Take it home

Your finished terrarium leaves with you. Monty also shares care tips so your tiny world thrives at home.

what's included

your host

Meet Monty

You'll be in great hands — Monty has spent over a decade helping people reconnect with nature through plants, design, and community.

Monty Sharma

Biophilic Designer · Urban Permaculturist · Founder, Urban Botanica Co.

Based in Newcastle, NSW, Monty founded Urban Botanica Collective in 2018 with a mission to reconnect people with the natural world through biophilic design, permaculture, and living green spaces. With 14+ years of hands-on experience, his workshops are as calming as the terrariums you build in them.
